en: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David.

zh: 上帝的榮耀和人的尊貴
大衛的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。

ja: 指揮者のために。ガテの楽器に合わせて。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

ja: においてなんと威厳に満ちていることか。 あなたはご自身の
en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
u.src: 1  LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

p.src: 2  From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

ja: を定められた。 それは、
en: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
u.src: 2  From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

p.src: 3  When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

en: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
u.src: 3  When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

p.src: 4  what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

en: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
u.src: 4  what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

p.src: 5  For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

ja: いたち よりも少し
en: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
u.src: 5  For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

ja: 8:5 ヘブル語：אֱלֹהִים（エロヒム）。ここで用いられているエロヒムという言葉は通常「神」を意味するが、「神々」「君主たち」または「御使いたち」を意味することもある。七十人訳はここで「御使いたち」と読んでいる。ヘブル人への手紙2章7節の七十人訳からの引用も参照。
en: 8:5 Hebrew: Elohim. The word Elohim, used here, usually means “God”, but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”. The Septuagint reads “angels” here. See also the quote from the Septuagint in Hebrews 2:7.

p.src: 6  You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet: 7  All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field, 8  the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

ja: あなたは、御手の業の上に彼を支配者とされた。 あなたはすべてのものを彼の足の下に置かれた。
すべての羊と牛、 そう、野の獣たちも、
zh: 你派他管理你手所造的， 使萬物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的獸、空中的鳥、海裏的魚， 凡經行海道的，都服在他的腳下。
en: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
u.src: 6  You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet: 7  All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field, 8  the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

p.src: 9  LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

ja: においてなんと威厳に満ちていることか。
en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
u.src: 9  LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
